title: Fixed angle inverse scattering with non-constant velocity
summary: In this article, we study formally determined inverse problems for wave equations in the presence of a variable sound speed. We prove that by measuring the boundary data of finitely many plane waves and their complementary solutions, one can uniquely recover the unknown coefficients of the highest order terms of a second order hyperbolic operator with time independent coefficients. This improves earlier rigidity results in [10], [11] which compared the wave operator generated by a Riemannian metric with the wave operator generated by the Euclidean metric.
